laws.doc: Lemma 6.12, the other direction (no premise: whiskering, Lemma 6.2): f = g implies h o f = h o g.

laws.doc: Non-vacuity of core_inj_push's CF premise (whitepaper L21, G11): the successor on Nat is collision-free on every pair, so cf is inhabited (h = successor, any f and g).
